## Law of total probability

If $(B_n)$ partitions $\Omega$, then $P(A) = \sum_n P(A \cap B_n)$.

## Independence

Events are independent when intersections factor into products of probabilities.

## Conditional probability

$P(A\mid B) = P(A \cap B) / P(B)$ when $P(B) > 0$.
